title: 6515--BRAND NAME OR EQUAL | HemoSphere, SEPG 400796 EER 275098
agency_path: VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF.VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF.261-NETWORK CONTRACT OFFICE 21 (36C261)
detail_text: PRE-SOLICITATION NOTICE THIS IS A PRE-SOLICITATION ANNOUNCEMENT. Department of Veterans Affairs Network Contracting Office 21 will be issuing a Request for Quote (RFQ) to provide Hemospheres and associated equipment for the VA Southern Nevada Healthcare System, 6900 North Pecos Road, Las Vegas, NV 89086. Please refer to the solicitation for a summary of the items requested and any additional procurement details. A Request for Quote using the following NAICS is contemplated: 339113. THIS RFQ SHALL BE UNRESTRICTED ON THE OPEN MARKET. THIS SHALL BE A BRAND NAME OR EQUAL REQUIREMENT. Solicitation documents will be available on or about April 2, 2026. The solicitation will contain quote instructions. The Government intends to award one (1) Firm-Fixed Price Contract. Questions regarding the solicitation shall be sent in writing to Mathew.czeshinski@va.gov
